subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should security workflow owners accept this dependency refresh only after the TruffleHog executable pin is aligned and the rebased branch preserves current-main security-action revisions?
rationale: The mechanical defect is clear, but this PR changes third-party actions that scan repository contents, upload SARIF, and authenticate to registries; the protected security label and CODEOWNERS assignment require an owner decision on the refreshed exact head.

options.title: Repair and refresh before review
options.body: Update TruffleHog’s explicit scanner version and digest to v3.96.0, rebase onto current main, and request security-owner review of the resulting action pins.

options.title: Close and recreate the Dependabot update
options.body: If Dependabot cannot update its branch because it lacks repository access, close this stale head and let a fresh dependency update target the current workflow baseline.

recommendation.title: Repair and refresh before review
recommendation.body: Update TruffleHog’s explicit scanner version and digest to v3.96.0, rebase onto current main, and request security-owner review of the resulting action pins.

likelyOwner.reason: This group owns the changed CodeQL security workflows and is the repository’s designated reviewer for this security-sensitive workflow surface.
